verdict.rationale: incident.io has a first-party webhooks page saying webhooks deliver notifications when events occur in incident.io. Its stated uses include annotating monitoring graphs, tracking follow-ups, and syncing on-call data such as alerts, escalations and schedule changes to external tools. That is outbound event subscription for programmatic consumers. Missing for 10: an enumerated event-type catalog, documentation of endpoint registration, payload signing and retry behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
